mapper.select: select sitecode, enabled, schemajson, updateuser, date_format(updatetime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') updatetime from u_s_orderwizard where sitecode = (select sitecode from u_s_siteinfo limit 1)
mapper.insert: insert into u_s_orderwizard(sitecode, enabled, schemajson, updateuser, updatetime) select sitecode, coalesce(#{enabled}, 0), #{schemaJson}, #{updateUser}, sysdate() from u_s_siteinfo limit 1 on duplicate key update enabled = values(enabled), schemajson = values(schemajson), updateuser = values(updateuser), updatetime = values(updatetime)
